steps.title: Bem-vindo: Sports - Volume 33
steps.text: In this B2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Sports". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: They won the championship last year.
He missed the penalty in the last minute.
The match ended in a tie.

steps.title: Idiom: Bite the bullet
steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
